mutant.lineText: if (s.used + cost > w.limit) return fail(this.#refuse('window', 429, `the ${w.name} limit of ${w.limit} is used`, resetMs, { 'RateLimit-Limit': String(w.limit), 'RateLimit-Remaining': '0', 'RateLimit-Reset': String(Math.ceil(resetMs / 1000)) }));
